\documentclass[paper={a5paper},maintitle={Verse Modifiers Test}]{ulsbs-songbook}
\makeatletter
\def\ULtestverse#1#2{%
  \ifdim\tmp@UL@currentverseextraindentwidth=#1\relax\else
    \errmessage{verse indentation did not match #1}%
  \fi
  \ifdim\baselineadj=#2\relax\else
    \errmessage{verse baseline did not match #2}%
  \fi
}
\def\ULtestverseended{\ifdim\baselineadj=2pt\relax\else
  \errmessage{verse baseline was not restored}\fi}
\def\ULtestnumbered{\ifvnumbered\else\errmessage{verse was not numbered}\fi}
\def\ULtestunnumbered{\ifvnumbered\errmessage{verse was numbered}\fi}
\def\ULtestmelodyverse#1{%
  \ifdim\tmp@UL@currentverseextraindentwidth=#1\relax\else
    \errmessage{melody verse indentation did not match #1}\fi
  \ifdim\baselineadj>2pt\relax\else
    \errmessage{melody verse baseline was not increased}\fi}
\makeatother
\begin{document}
\begin{songs}{}
\beginsong{Verse Modifiers}
  \baselineadj=2pt
  \beginverse\ULtestverse{0pt}{2pt}\ULtestnumbered
    |\[C]Plain verse.
  \endverse\ULtestverseended
  \beginverse[2]\ULtestverse{\dimexpr2\verseindentwidthbase\relax}{2pt}\ULtestnumbered
    |\[C]Indented verse.
  \endverse\ULtestverseended
  \beginverse*\ULtestverse{0pt}{2pt}\ULtestunnumbered
    |\[C]Unnumbered verse.
  \endverse\ULtestverseended
  \beginverse*[2]\ULtestverse{\dimexpr2\verseindentwidthbase\relax}{2pt}\ULtestunnumbered
    |\[C]Unnumbered indented verse.
  \endverse\ULtestverseended
  \beginverse+\ULtestmelodyverse{0pt}\ULtestnumbered
    |\[<C>Am]Melody verse.
  \endverse\ULtestverseended
  \beginverse+[2]\ULtestmelodyverse{\dimexpr2\verseindentwidthbase\relax}\ULtestnumbered
    |\[<C>Am]Indented melody verse.
  \endverse\ULtestverseended
  \beginverse*+\ULtestmelodyverse{0pt}\ULtestunnumbered
    |\[<C>Am]Unnumbered melody verse.
  \endverse\ULtestverseended
  \beginverse*+[2]\ULtestmelodyverse{\dimexpr2\verseindentwidthbase\relax}\ULtestunnumbered
    |\[<C>Am]Unnumbered indented melody verse.
  \endverse\ULtestverseended
  \notesoff
  \beginverse+\ULtestverse{0pt}{2pt}
    |\[C]Hidden melody notes leave baseline alone.
  \endverse\ULtestverseended
  \noteson
\endsong
\end{songs}
\makeatletter
\ifcsname mnbeginverse\endcsname\errmessage{obsolete verse start still defined}\fi
\ifcsname mnendverse\endcsname\errmessage{obsolete verse end still defined}\fi
\makeatother
\end{document}
